description: MCP server configuration for the kiosk ordering agent

servers.name: kiosk-core
servers.description: Kiosk ordering tools — list products, place/update/confirm orders, get upsell suggestions. NOTE: the trailing slash is required — without it the MCP mount answers every request with a 307 redirect to the canonical slashed path, so each tool call paid two round trips instead of one (visible as paired '307 Temporary Redirect' + '200 OK' lines in the rag-service logs).
